title: The Last Dance
text: A waltz from another age drifts from a ruined ballroom, where ghosts in gowns of mist and coats of dust dance among the fallen chandeliers. They turn and turn. One of them stops and holds out a hand to the party's most troubled soul.

options.label: The most troubled takes the ghost's hand, longing for one moment of grace.

outcomes.text: They share one dance, slow and cold, and come away lighter.
One dance becomes another, then another. They cannot stop, and the ghosts do not want them to.

options.label: Everyone dances, that the dead might have company for one more night.

outcomes.text: It is a long night among the dead, and a good one. By dawn your feet ache.

options.label: Leave them to their ball. The dead have their own music.

outcomes.text: The music follows you to the edge of the ruin. Long after, the Leader wonders what that dance would have been.
